finding: No useful primary personal advantage is established. Useful base and pooled advantage remains unresolved under both interval methods; useful donor and uniform advantage is excluded under both. All primary intervals include zero. Adapted-minus-base donor and pooled useful advantage remains unresolved under both methods. Residual uniform useful advantage is excluded under both methods, and all residual intervals include zero. Raw base and pooled useful advantage remains unresolved under both methods. Raw donor useful advantage is excluded under writer resampling but unresolved under crossed resampling; all raw model-rival intervals include zero. Raw sums are worse than uniform under both methods. No parity follows.
limits: Full final documents include accepted model insertions; this is not human-only learning. Sparse histories, overlapping human units, fixed donor/global training and exposed prompts bound the tested recipe. No independent human confirmation, corpus/seed/rank ranking, population limit, private-goal inference or whole-matrix verdict. Earlier failed/unknown attempts remain separate; no new retry.
